decisions.title: A precise study set
decisions.description: Pathogenic registry variants only; other sources annotate.

decisions.title: Organized by delivery method
decisions.description: Shared evidence linked across six workstreams.

decisions.title: Reuse before repeating
decisions.description: Exact analysis identity and provenance specified.

decisions.title: An iterative research process
decisions.description: Hourly when actionable; daily when idle. Not active yet.

workstreams.name: Lentiviral delivery
workstreams.summary: Ex vivo approaches, corrected cells, and long-term evidence.
workstreams.description: Review published ex vivo approaches and the rationale linking corrected hematopoietic cells to disease-specific outcomes.
questions: Which clinical phenotype and stage does the published evidence address?
How are durability, conditioning burden, and genotoxicity characterized?
Which findings generalize across eligible variant classes, and which remain untested?

workstreams.name: AAV delivery
workstreams.summary: Target cells, delivery barriers, and model-system limits.
workstreams.description: Evaluate relevant AAV gene-delivery evidence, including target-tissue coverage, biological context, durability, and safety questions.
questions: Which target cells and tissues require correction for the stated phenotype?
What experimental evidence supports delivery in a relevant biological system?
Which durability, immune, and model-transfer limitations remain?

workstreams.name: Other viral vectors
workstreams.summary: A defined place for relevant alternative viral platforms.
workstreams.description: Establish whether other viral-vector approaches have relevant ABCD1 evidence or a defensible comparative research rationale.
questions: Is there direct ABCD1 evidence for the proposed platform?
What specific research question justifies comparison?
Which conclusions are general platform knowledge rather than ABCD1-specific evidence?

workstreams.name: Nonviral carriers
workstreams.summary: Lipid nanoparticles and other supported carrier systems.
workstreams.description: Review supported carrier platforms with cargo, formulation, target-cell context, delivery evidence, and persistence recorded separately.
questions: What cargo and target-cell context are supported by the evidence?
How is delivery distinguished from downstream biological correction?
What evidence is missing for the intended ABCD1 disease setting?

workstreams.name: Physical delivery
workstreams.summary: Ex vivo physical and carrier-free delivery methods.
workstreams.description: Review physical delivery methods such as electroporation in the appropriate cell context, separating delivery from editing strategy and cell-product administration.
questions: Which cell type and cargo does the evidence address?
How are cellular viability and function assessed?
Which downstream outcomes require separate validation?

workstreams.name: Combined systems
workstreams.summary: Multiple delivery components, one traceable evidence record.
workstreams.description: Represent approaches with more than one delivery component and studies comparing multiple methods through shared, linked records.
questions: What role does each delivery component play?
Which test conditions define the exact analysis identity?
How is evidence counted once when it appears in several workstream views?

milestones.title: Define the research scope
milestones.description: A broad therapeutic landscape with separate comparisons by disease setting.

milestones.title: Set the Pathogenic-only eligibility policy
milestones.description: The adrenoleukodystrophy.info classification alone defines study-target eligibility.

milestones.title: Select the initial tool stack
milestones.description: Core and conditional tools documented with sources, access terms, and compute limits.

milestones.title: Specify the tests-and-predictions database
milestones.description: Provenance, exact duplicate checks, retries, and intentional replication defined.

milestones.title: Define vector-method organization
milestones.description: Delivery system, strategy, cargo, cell context, and disease setting remain distinct.

milestones.title: Choose the iterative research cadence
milestones.description: Hourly while actionable; daily while idle, with checkpoint recovery and stop conditions.

milestones.title: Import and audit an eligible cohort
milestones.description: Create a versioned manifest from explicit Pathogenic registry entries. No manifest has been imported into this tracker.

milestones.title: Implement the scientific registry
milestones.description: Create the database, immutable analysis identities, artifact checksums, and eligibility checks.

milestones.title: Build and validate analysis adapters
milestones.description: Validate Mutalyzer/VEP mappings and evidence-source clients before variant-specific jobs.

milestones.title: Import source-linked evidence
milestones.description: Separate publications, experimental structures, prediction outputs, and clinical findings.

milestones.title: Compare delivery methods within disease settings
milestones.description: Use relevant endpoints and clearly state evidence gaps and model limitations.

milestones.title: Run and validate the initial computational pilot
milestones.description: Execute a bounded public-data pilot with useful outputs and defined acceptance checks.

milestones.title: Activate the resumable background loop
milestones.description: Enable scheduling only after implementation and a successful manual validation run.

milestones.title: Connect reviewed results to this public tracker
milestones.description: Publish sanitized, source-linked progress snapshots from the research database. The first website is a curated snapshot.

tools.name: ABCD1 Variant Registry
tools.description: Sole source for the versioned Pathogenic-only study set.
tools.access: Public catalog; verify export and reuse terms

tools.name: PubMed + Europe PMC
tools.description: Reproducible literature searches with persistent publication identifiers.
tools.access: Public APIs; observe rate and full-text reuse limits

tools.name: NLM PubTator 3.0
tools.description: Find biomedical entities and reported relationships; check extracted claims against original sources.

tools.name: Mutalyzer 3
tools.description: Validate and normalize HGVS while preserving source reference versions.
tools.access: MIT software; public service or local CPU

tools.name: Ensembl VEP + Variant Recoder
tools.description: Annotate transcript and protein consequences using verified assembly and transcript mappings.
tools.access: Apache-2.0 software; external annotation terms vary

tools.name: RCSB PDB + Mol*
tools.description: Inspect existing experimental ABCD1 structures and their construct and validation details.

tools.name: AlphaFold DB
tools.description: Use existing reference predictions when they add useful structural context.
tools.access: CC BY 4.0 prediction data; no inference GPU needed

tools.name: FDA, DailyMed + ClinicalTrials.gov
tools.description: Follow authoritative labeling, safety updates, trial records, and published endpoints.
tools.access: Public sources; preserve revisions and data cutoffs

tools.name: Python + SQLite
tools.description: Store analysis identity, cohort versions, results, attempts, and provenance. Planned implementation.
tools.access: Native CPU; SQLite deliverable code public domain

tools.name: Snakemake + Git + uv
tools.description: Track workflow dependencies, code history, and locked environments. Scientific deduplication stays in the database.
tools.access: Free software; Snakemake's documented Windows route uses WSL

tools.name: ASReview LAB
tools.description: Prioritize large literature sets through active learning from reviewer relevance labels.

tools.name: Pangolin / SpliceAI
tools.description: Address a specific splice-mechanism question; model agreement is not RNA validation.
tools.access: Pangolin GPL-3.0; SpliceAI code/weights have noncommercial restrictions

tools.name: Precomputed AlphaMissense
tools.description: Secondary information for eligible missense variants; does not establish therapeutic response.

tools.name: AlphaGenome Atlas/API
tools.description: Investigate expression, chromatin, or splicing effects with verified hg38 mapping.
tools.access: Free noncommercial API; key and separate output terms

tools.name: DESeq2 + Scanpy
tools.description: Analyze suitable count and single-cell datasets with proper biological replication.
tools.access: Free software; dataset suitability and memory checks first

tools.name: CRISPOR / Cas-OFFinder / CRISPResso2
tools.description: Different roles in candidate assessment, off-target nomination, and analysis of actual editing data.
tools.access: Use and runtime restrictions vary; eligibility and validation first
